title: Maintenance > "Send logs by email" is not fetching recent .zip files
symptom: When exporting logs from Maintenance, wrong files are fetched: instead of the latest 4, it picks the latest .log and 3 .zip files from further in the past. Also, file naming has changed with "00_00" in all file names.
evidence_quote: When doing exports of logs from Maintenance it seem that wrong files are being fetched. Instead of 4 latest it's picking latest .log and 3 .zip files further down in the past that isn't relevant.
